description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the EmployeeEducationService component of the OrangeHRM system. It contains tests for retrieving and setting the EmployeeEducationDao inside the EmployeeEducationService.

classes.name: EmployeeEducationServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for EmployeeEducationService, testing DAO retrieval and setting methods.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes a new EmployeeEducationService instance before each test.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeEducationDao
methods.description: Verifies that getEmployeeEducationDao returns an instance of EmployeeEducationDao.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeEducationDaoBySetter
methods.description: Tests that setting the DAO manually results in getEmployeeEducationDao returning an EmployeeEducationDao instance.
